title: Library welcome · Quick practice
narration: You and Haru visit a community library. Sumi is the librarian. In four short replies, greet her, explain your purpose, clarify a new word, and present your student card. There is no timer.

opening.japanese: 図書館の利用登録をしに来ました。すみさんに聞いてみましょう。
opening.romaji: Toshokan no riyou touroku o shi ni kimashita. Sumi-san ni kiite mimashou.

decisions.prompt: Greet Sumi politely at the library desk.
decisions.hint: Begin with a greeting, not a demand.

setup.japanese: こんにちは。図書館へようこそ。

choices.japanese: こんにちは。よろしくお願いします。
choices.feedbackWhy: Your greeting acknowledges Sumi before asking for help.

reaction.japanese: こんにちは。どうぞ、ご用件をお聞かせください。
reaction.romaji: Konnichiwa. Douzo, goyouken o okikase kudasai.

choices.feedbackWhy: This demands speed instead of greeting an unfamiliar staff member.

reaction.japanese: まず、ご挨拶をしてからお話ししましょう。
reaction.romaji: Mazu, goaisatsu o shite kara ohanashi shimashou.

timeout.japanese: 練習なので、ゆっくり考えて大丈夫です。
timeout.romaji: Renshuu na node, yukkuri kangaete daijoubu desu.

decisions.prompt: Tell Sumi you want to borrow a book.
decisions.hint: Name what you want to do: borrow a book.

setup.japanese: 本を借りたいですか。それとも、返したいですか。
setup.romaji: Hon o karitai desu ka. Soretomo, kaeshitai desu ka.

choices.feedbackWhy: This directly answers whether you want to borrow or return a book.

reaction.japanese: 貸出ですね。初めての方には、登録をご案内します。
reaction.romaji: Kashidashi desu ne. Hajimete no kata ni wa, touroku o goannai shimasu.

choices.feedbackTitle: Tell her which service you need
choices.feedbackWhy: Anything is fine does not tell Sumi that you want to borrow a book.

reaction.japanese: 借りたいのか、返したいのか教えてください。
reaction.romaji: Karitai no ka, kaeshitai no ka oshiete kudasai.

timeout.japanese: 借りたいことを、短く伝えましょう。

decisions.prompt: You do not know what riyou touroku means. Ask Sumi to explain it.
decisions.hint: Name the unfamiliar expression and ask what it means.

setup.japanese: 初めて本を借りる方は、利用登録が必要です。
setup.romaji: Hajimete hon o kariru kata wa, riyou touroku ga hitsuyou desu.

choices.japanese: すみません、利用登録とは何ですか。
choices.romaji: Sumimasen, riyou touroku to wa nan desu ka.
choices.feedbackWhy: You identify the unfamiliar term, so Sumi knows exactly what to explain.

reaction.japanese: 本を借りるための登録です。学生証があれば、ここで登録できます。
reaction.romaji: Hon o kariru tame no touroku desu. Gakuseishou ga areba, koko de touroku dekimasu.

choices.feedbackWhy: The situation says you do not understand the expression. Claiming to understand prevents clarification.

reaction.japanese: 分からない言葉があれば、遠慮なく聞いてくださいね。
reaction.romaji: Wakaranai kotoba ga areba, enryo naku kiite kudasai ne.

timeout.japanese: 分からない言葉は、聞いても大丈夫です。
timeout.romaji: Wakaranai kotoba wa, kiite mo daijoubu desu.

decisions.prompt: You have your student card. Present it clearly to Sumi.
decisions.hint: Confirm that you have it and present the requested card.

setup.japanese: 登録に使う学生証は、お持ちですか。
setup.romaji: Touroku ni tsukau gakuseishou wa, omochi desu ka.

choices.japanese: はい、こちらが学生証です。
choices.feedbackWhy: This confirms that you have the requested student card and presents it.

reaction.japanese: ありがとうございます。では、こちらで登録しましょう。
reaction.romaji: Arigatou gozaimasu. Dewa, kochira de touroku shimashou.

choices.feedbackWhy: You have the card, so present it rather than leaving Sumi unsure.

reaction.japanese: 確認して、見せていただけますか。

timeout.japanese: 学生証を確認して、見せましょう。
